title: Pure Arcana Force
summary: Arcana Force cards with generic coin-toss support and staples. Every Arcana Force monster tosses a coin on summon to determine whether it applies its beneficial Heads effect or detrimental Tails effect, and Light Barrier lets you choose the result instead of flipping.

summary.title: Starters
points: Light Force discards a card to search two Arcana Force monsters from the Deck, setting up your entire hand at once.
Arcana Force XV - The Fiend discards itself from the hand to search Light Barrier directly from the Deck.

Arcana Force XIX - The Sun Special Summons itself from the hand while a card with a coin-tossing effect is on the field, and on Heads Sets a Spell from the Deck that has a coin-tossing effect (such as Light Barrier or Light Force).

Arcana Force V - The Hierophant can be discarded so the opponent cannot respond to your Arcana Force summons that turn, and on Heads Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Arcana Force with a different name from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Light Force or The Fiend + The Hierophant
steps: Discard Arcana Force XV - The Fiend to search Light Barrier, then activate Light Barrier so you can choose Heads for every Arcana Force summon.
Normal Summon Arcana Force V - The Hierophant and choose Heads to Special Summon a different Level 4 or lower Arcana Force from the Deck.
Special Summon Arcana Force XIX - The Sun from the hand and choose Heads to Set a coin-toss Spell from the Deck.
Send three Arcana Force monsters with different names from the field to the GY to Contact Fuse Arcana Force EX - The Chaos Ruler.

summary.title: Light Barrier & The Chaos Ruler
summary.text: Arcana Force EX - The Chaos Ruler is a Contact Fusion of three differently named Arcana Force monsters (which is why the list runs singletons of the low-Level tarot lineup). On Heads it Special Summons a Level 10 Arcana Force (The Light Ruler, The Dark Ruler or The World) from the hand or Deck ignoring its Summoning conditions; on Tails it adds a card from the Deck that has a coin-tossing effect; and while Light Barrier is in the Field Zone, the opponent cannot activate the effects of monsters on the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Arcana Force XXI - The World (Heads) sends 2 monsters you control to the GY during your End Phase to skip the opponent's next turn entirely.
Arcana Force EX - The Light Ruler (4000 ATK) recovers any card from your GY after destroying a monster by battle on Heads, and negates targeting effects.
Arcana Force EX - The Dark Ruler (4000 ATK) makes a second attack during each Battle Phase on Heads.
Reversal of Fate flips a face-up Arcana Force monster's coin result between Heads and Tails.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Arcana Force XII - The Hangman is not yet released in the TCG.
